podcast.title: Death (August 1995)
podcast.body: Dwayne Goettel, identified as "Duane Gatell" and a member of Skinny Puppy, died in August 1995 from a heroin overdose. "Duane Gatell, skinny puppy, heroin overdose, August 1995."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
